---
title: I-adic completions 
subtitle: We use standard material on limits to understand some basic problem about iterated completions
date: 2026-10-29
categories: [math, formal]
---

{{< include /_macros.qmd >}}

We want to answer the following question: If $R$ is any ring and $I=(f_1,\ldots, f_m)$ is a finitely generated ideal in $R$, then is the $I$-adic completion of $R$ the $f_m$-adic completion of $(f_1,\ldots,f_{m-1})$-adic completion of $R$?
